purpose: Pre-execution registration package only; no confirmatory paired analysis has been run.

confidence_interval_method.proposal: Percentile nonparametric paired bootstrap of the mean paired difference.
confidence_interval_method.rationale: The estimand is the mean of query-level paired differences; resampling whole query pairs preserves the within-query Oracle-vs-Fixed-10 pairing and needs no normality assumption.
confidence_interval_method.impact: The CI bounds directly determine the Gate A outcome; a different registered interval changes the inferential procedure and must be frozen before observing the result.

resampling_unit.proposal: One development query's complete paired difference.
resampling_unit.rationale: Queries are the registered evaluation units; resampling ranking rows/documents would break the paired query-level estimand.
resampling_unit.impact: Defines the sampling interpretation of the CI.

resampling_count.rationale: Provides stable percentile endpoints while remaining a practical fixed reproducibility setting.
resampling_count.impact: Must be fixed because Monte Carlo precision and reproducibility depend on it.

seed.rationale: A dedicated, recorded seed makes the resampling realization reproducible and is not selected from results.
seed.impact: Changing it changes finite-resample CI endpoints.

confidence_level.rationale: Matches the draft protocol's requested 95% CI.
confidence_level.impact: Must be implemented as two-sided 2.5th/97.5th percentile endpoints if the bootstrap proposal is approved.

edge_cases.proposal: Use the existing nDCG implementation, including its defined zero return when IDCG is zero; retain zero paired differences in the mean and bootstrap; fail before inference on missing, duplicate, extra, or misaligned IDs or unavailable required budget rankings.
edge_cases.rationale: Preserves the registered metric and makes population/data failures explicit rather than silently filtering queries.
edge_cases.impact: Controls both the estimand population and reproducibility of the reported N.

additional_inference.proposal: Report the mean difference and the registered CI only for Gate A; treat the stated bound rule as the decision criterion and do not add an unregistered significance test.
additional_inference.rationale: Avoids post-hoc test selection and follows the protocol's CI-based Gate A rule.
